diagnostic_gate: Equal-size comparator screens and 10,000-draw random null
what_would_support_alternative: A population, airport, station-density, climate or demand benchmark reproduces the 651-component canonical screen.
result: Observed overlaps are 1.23–16.59%; random 95% range 3.99–7.53%. Climate is the largest comparator but does not reproduce the canonical set.

what_would_support_alternative: The pooled relation is unchanged after separating within- from between-country structure.
result: Within-country slope is -0.064 while between-country slope is 0.421; country-FE shares 447 components with canonical; 441 form the canonical–available-field–country-FE core.
blocked_interpretation: Not a universal within-country scaling law or national-capacity ranking.

what_would_support_alternative: The canonical object disappears among denominator-certain components.
result: 175 canonical components are denominator-certain and 476 uncertain; uncertainty is attached to component-level use.
blocked_interpretation: Not a metadata-only artefact; denominator confidence remains explicit.

diagnostic_gate: 1,000 weight draws, model overlap and threshold grid
what_would_support_alternative: The continuous ranking and persistent core collapse under reasonable definitions.
result: 490 canonical components recur in at least half of draws, 214 in at least 80%, and 441 form the cross-model core; fringe membership remains definition-sensitive.

what_would_support_alternative: Positive precipitation consistency exists only because need contains weather_hazard_proxy.
result: The no-hazard screen shares 419 canonical components and retains a positive event-date estimate of 0.45 mm; higher-level intervals cross zero.
blocked_interpretation: Not direct validation of the constituent proxy or named hazards.

diagnostic_gate: Exact q75 alignment, controls, leave-outs and within-event permutation
what_would_support_alternative: The signal disappears when dates must satisfy canonical q75, or controls reproduce it.
result: The primary stream contains 152 dates; event-date contrast is 0.41 mm (0.08–0.73), higher-level intervals cross zero, placebo touches zero and false-event is imprecise.

diagnostic_gate: Released-field reconstruction plus provenance boundary ledger
what_would_support_alternative: The downstream score cannot be reconstructed or unavailable upstream steps are presented as known.
result: Standardisation, equal-weight need, residual sign and canonical thresholds are reconstructible; polygons, station-hour processing, proxy formulas and original GDP-inclusive fit are bounded.
blocked_interpretation: Not full raw-data reproduction or total observing-capacity census.
